name: Temple of Anahita, Bishapur
scope: The surviving excavated Temple of Anahita at Bishapur as documented in March 2025. Includes the sunken square stone court, wall masses and visible stone openings. Adjacent ruins, speculative ancient roof and underground passages are outside the model.

stories.title: Temple of Anahita: Where Water Was Worship

originalReview.notes: View from the excavated court records the massive laid stone blocks, rectangular doorways, floor paving and irregular stepped wall top.

review.method: Exact published Qualla originals with native Commons SHA-1, pinned revisions and explicit CC0 dedication
review.notes: One exact published Qualla original by Behnam9395 was accepted under the photographer’s explicit CC0 dedication. Photographs with inferred authorship were set aside.
